name: Ciliopathies with Major Skeletal Involvement

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Ciliopathies with Skeletal Involvement

criteria.description: Presence of major skeletal abnormalities such as polydactyly, short ribs, or limb shortening
Evidence of primary cilia dysfunction via genetic testing or functional assays
Involvement of at least one additional organ system commonly affected in ciliopathies (e.g., renal cystic disease, retinal dystrophy)
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive or dominant inheritance
Radiological evidence of characteristic skeletal abnormalities such as cone-shaped epiphyses or narrow thorax

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: skeletal dysplasia, ciliary dysfunction, and multisystem involvement
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation is highly supportive but not mandatory if clinical criteria are met.

searchTerms: small thoracic cage due to rib abnormalities
shortened rib bones causing narrow chest

rare.symptomName: Polydipsia and polyuria due to nephrogenic diabetes insipidus
searchTerms: excessive thirst and urination from kidney diabetes insipidus
increased drinking and peeing due to kidney water imbalance
nephrogenic diabetes insipidus causing polyuria and polydipsia

laboratory: Elevated liver enzymes in hepatic fibrosis
imaging: Radiographs showing short ribs and cone-shaped epiphyses
MRI of brain may show cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in some subtypes
genetic: Mutations in genes encoding ciliary proteins (e.g., IFT80, DYNC2H1, WDR19)
Autosomal recessive or dominant inheritance patterns
other: Functional assays demonstrating impaired ciliary motility or structure
Family history consistent with ciliopathy syndromes

distinguishingFeatures: Primarily thoracic skeletal involvement without prominent retinal or renal disease
Genetic mutations distinct from other ciliopathies
More severe skeletal abnormalities with perinatal lethality
Distinct radiographic features and genetic mutations

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to thoracic insufficiency
Early onset retinal degeneration leading to vision loss
references: Waters AM, Beales PL. Ciliopathies: an expanding disease spectrum. Pediatr Nephrol. 2011;26(7):1039-56.
